svg.data-spec:
title: funcd local API kind: flow dir: down
[Worker] blue right code: Code | ctx calls shim: Shim [/]
local: Local API | a socket per worker @blue
[Asks Cedar] green 4 kvf: kv | KV blobf: blob | Buckets sqlf: sql | SQL databases secretf: secret | Secrets invokef: invoke | over a link fetchf: fetch | over a link jobf: job | starts a run addonf: addon | an engine [/]
healthf: health | binding check @blue
cedarq: Cedar allows? | the binding's action @purple cok: Served | the store, call or run @green cno: Refused | 403 Forbidden @red
code > shim > local local > Asks Cedar local > healthf Asks Cedar > cedarq cedarq > cok: allow cedarq > cno: deny
